== LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001.jpg, overview of face 1) ==
Observations:
- Single paper(?) leaf, upright, one column of text, about 38 long lines. No visible ruling at overview scale. No running title visible. Top margin carries a small mark "1." or similar at centre top (possibly a folio/quire number).
- Script: small, rapid cursive book/notarial hand, heavily abbreviated, brown ink. No rubrics, no enlarged initials; section openings marked by slightly larger letters within the line (e.g. a capital-like form in mid-line line ~7, ~19, ~26).
- Several wormholes / dark holes across the leaf (left edge especially, top-left, upper middle). Edges ragged; lower right corner chipped.
- Ink stamp lower right "BIBLIOTHECA GANDAVENSIS". Scale bar below.
- No interlinear or marginal glosses visible at overview scale, except a few interlinear abbreviation letters.
Tentative interpretation: continuous prose treatise; at overview scale the vocabulary seems grammatical (words like "relatiu(us)", "interrogatiu(us)", "infinitiu(us)", "antecedent(e)", "clausula", "construitur") -- to be checked on tiles.
Tiles: image-002..005 are presumably native-resolution tiles of this face; image-006 presumably overview of face 2 with tiles image-007..010.

Script notes (from first tile): cursive with looped ascenders; z-like sign (3/z) used for -us/-et after b ("quibz", "ambz"); 4-like sign after o = -rum; "ꝯ" = con-/com-; superscript letters frequent (videt^r etc.). Spans in face 1 are read across the full line. Abbreviated words given literally with expansions in parentheses; much remains uncertain.
